title: Pullback from the point is an equivalence on module objects over a separably closed field
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, that is a commutative monoid object in abelian condensed sheaves on profinite sets [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For a scheme $X$ let $p_X^*$ be the pullback from the point [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and $p_X^*\colon\operatorname{Mod}_\Lambda\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ the induced functor on module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. If $\Omega$ is a separably closed field and $X=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, then $p_X^*\colon\operatorname{Mod}_\Lambda\to\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ is an equivalence of categories (the pro-étale site of $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ being equivalent to profinite sets through $S\mapsto\operatorname{Spec}LC(S,\Omega)$ [det-pe-condensed-point-basis]).
